spans.s:
रिरिक्वस्, वान्, m., Ved. one who has emaciated
or attenuated (his body by austerities, Ṛg-veda

रिरंसा रिरंसा, f. (fr. Desid. of rt. रम्),
the desire to rejoice or be pleased, wish to sport;
desire of pleasure or sexual enjoyment, lasciviousness,
lustfulness.

रिरंसु, उस्, उस्, उ, desiring to rejoice, wishing to
sport, wishing for sexual pleasures, lustful, wanton,
lascivious.

रिरमयिषु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. Desid. of Caus.),
wishing to cause or give pleasure (especially sexual
pleasure).

रिरक्षिषा रिरक्षिषा, f. (fr. the Desid. of
rt. 1. रक्ष्), the desire to watch or keep guard,
wish to protect.
रिरक्षा, f. less correct for the above.

रिरक्षिषु, उस्, उस्, उ, desiring to watch or keep
guard, wishing to protect.
रिरक्षु, less correct for रिरक्षिषु above.

रिरिक्षु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to injure or harm,
(this form is sometimes referred to rt. 1. रिष्.)

रिरी रिरी, f. yellow brass, pale brass,
prince's metal; [cf. रीरी, रीति.]
रीरी रीरी, f. = रिरी, yellow brass.

रिरिक्षत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, Ved. wishing to injure,
&c.; (अन्), m. an enemy.
रीर रीर, अस्, m., N. of Śiva.
